content.title: 2024 Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery Guideline
highlights: Guideline focuses on managing diabetic patients undergoing non-cardiac surgery, emphasizing glycemic control and the use of glucose-lowering medications.
Evaluation of perioperative analgesics and anesthetics, including ramifications of general versus regional anesthesia on postoperative outcomes.
Discussion on the role of various medications and their efficacy on pain management post-surgery, such as gabapentin and opioids.
Consideration of echocardiography techniques, especially transesophageal echocardiography, to monitor cardiac function during surgery.
Guideline references multiple clinical trials to provide evidence-based recommendations for perioperative care.

genes.context: Suggested Canadian standards for perioperative/periprocedural glycemic management in patients with type 1 or type 2 diabetes can consider SLC5A2 inhibitors.
Perioperative outcomes after regional versus general anesthesia for above the knee amputations demonstrate significance; ND4 mitochondrial mutations are also considered.
